name: boss-agent-cli-ops
title_zh: 装完 boss 命令行还要验登录
tagline_zh: 三条招聘 SOP 都卡在它前面：装完还得验登录、划红线，Windows 到 Linux 一套走通。
tagline_en: The shared prerequisite for all three recruiting SOPs: install, verify login, set safety rails once across.
desc_en: boss-agent-cli（命令 `boss`）的安装部署、登录验证与安全红线，Windows / macOS / Linux 通用。当用户要求"安装 boss-agent-cli / 配置初始化约束 / 重装环境 / 登录 BOSS"时应用，也作为三条招聘 SOP（screening、recommend-greet、resume-intake）的共同前置。
why_zh: 把安装、初始化约束、登录验证收成一条可复跑的前置，环境重装或换机时不用再凭记忆拼命令。
why_en: Bundles install, init constraints and login verification into one rerunnable prerequisite, so a rebuild or new machine needs no.
limit_zh: 只负责装好、验登录、划红线，不碰简历筛选和打招呼本身；登录要你本人在场扫码或输验证码，凭证过期它只能提示你重登。
limit_en: Only installs, verifies login and sets safety rails; no screening or greeting. Login needs you present for QR or SMS, and it won't renew expired.
title_en: Install, login-check and safety rails for the boss CLI
